name: Ceasg

attributes.attribute: often born from the mating of her kind
seized humans who entered her home

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Ceasg is a Highland mermaid of Scotland. She is half woman and half salmon. People call her the maiden of the wave. The Gaelic name is maighdean na tuinne. Sea captains were often born from her kind. She granted wishes to one who captured her. So many fairies did. But she could also seize humans. Entering her watery home cost most captives their lives.

okr.objective: The Ceasg is a Scottish mermaid who gave birth to sea captains.
